sources.title: GitHub - mx4ai/qwen2.5: Qwen2.5 is the large language model series ...
sources.snippet: Today, we are excited to introduce the latest addition to the Qwen family: Qwen2.5. Dense, easy-to-use, decoder-only language models, available in 0.5B, 1.5B, 3B, 7B, 14B, 32B, and 72B sizes, and base and instruct variants. Pretrained on our latest large-scale dataset, encompassing up to 18T tokens.

sources.title: Model Variants and Capabilities | QwenLM/Qwen2.5 | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: This page provides a comprehensive overview of the Qwen2.5 model variants, their sizes, architectures, and capabilities. It explains the different model sizes available, the distinction between base and instruction-tuned variants, and the key capabilities of each model. For information about using these models for inference, see Model Inference.

sources.snippet: We are excited to announce the release of Qwen3, the latest addition to the Qwen family of large language models. These models represent our most advanced and intelligent systems to date, improving from our experience in building QwQ and Qwen2.5.
